req.title: Deleting all tasks leaves empty table
req.statement: The system shall leave GET /tasks/ returning [] after every task has been deleted.
triggers: deleting all tasks leaves empty table

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-035 requires that after deleting every task, GET /tasks/ returns an empty list []. The test suite covers: (1) positive path — delete all 20 pre-loaded tasks one by one and verify GET /tasks/ returns exactly []; (2) negative path — attempt to delete a non-existent task ID and verify HTTP 404 with correct detail; (3) boundary path — delete the last remaining task (count transitions from 1 to 0) and verify the list becomes empty; (4) state-transition — verify intermediate state (tasks still present mid-deletion) then final empty state; (5) decision-table — verify that deleting a completed task and an incomplete task both succeed with 204. Each test uses an in-memory SQLite DB via dependency override to ensure isolation and determinism.

tests.name: test_delete_all_tasks_leaves_empty_list
preconditions: Database contains exactly 20 pre-loaded tasks with IDs 1-20
GET /tasks/ returns a non-empty list before deletion
actions: Override DB dependency with fresh in-memory SQLite
DELETE /tasks/{id} for each task ID 1 through 20
expected: GET /tasks/ returns HTTP 200 with body exactly []
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base
from app import models

engine_mem = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionMem = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem)

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionMem()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

db = SessionMem()
task_data = [
    {"title": f"Task {i}", "description": None, "completed": False}
    for i in range(1, 21)
]
for td in task_data:
    t = models.Task(title=td["title"], description=td["description"], completed=td["completed"])
    db.add(t)
db.commit()
all_tasks = db.query(models.Task).all()
task_ids = [t.id for t in all_tasks]
db.close()

assert len(task_ids) == 20

for tid in task_ids:
    r = client.delete(f"/tasks/{tid}")
    assert r.status_code == 204

r_get = client.get("/tasks/")
assert r_get.status_code == 200
assert r_get.json() == []

app.dependency_overrides.clear()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base
from app import models

engine_stc = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionStc = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_stc)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_stc)

def override_stc():
    db = SessionStc()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_stc
client_stc = TestClient(app)

db = SessionStc()
ids = []
for i in range(3):
    t = models.Task(title=f"Task {i}", description=None, completed=(i % 2 == 0))
    db.add(t)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(t)
    ids.append(t.id)
db.close()

r1 = client_stc.delete(f"/tasks/{ids[0]}")
assert r1.status_code == 204
r_mid1 = client_stc.get("/tasks/")
assert r_mid1.status_code == 200
assert len(r_mid1.json()) == 2

r2 = client_stc.delete(f"/tasks/{ids[1]}")
assert r2.status_code == 204
r_mid2 = client_stc.get("/tasks/")
assert r_mid2.status_code == 200
assert len(r_mid2.json()) == 1

r3 = client_stc.delete(f"/tasks/{ids[2]}")
assert r3.status_code == 204
r_final = client_stc.get("/tasks/")
assert r_final.status_code == 200
assert r_final.json() == []

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
